title: Order
description: A request to design a voice (type voice, designed or cloned from a clip) or generate a line (type line). Type sound is reserved for F7.

$schema.description: Schema reference so editors can validate and complete the file.

key.description: Order key: the voice key for a voice order, the line key for a line order.

type.description: Order type; sound is reserved for a later phase.

testText.description: voice: test sentence spoken in every take.

locale.description: voice: language variant (optional); a line takes the one of its voice.

designSheet.description: voice: design sheet the instruct is built from.

audio.description: Path of the clip (PCM WAV, 3 to 30 s) relative to the project root.

text.description: What the clip says, as spoken.

source.description: Free text: where the clip comes from (optional).

clip.description: voice: clip of a human voice, take 1 of a cloned voice (instead of designSheet and testText).

voice.description: line: key of the voice that speaks.

say.description: line: what the engine is given when it must differ from text (respelling, pronunciation); text if missing.

split.description: line: speak sentence by sentence and join the pieces with a silence.
